findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "inspect_business_website" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_discovery_readiness, summarize_scan_evidence · Private data: build_visibility_action_plan · Public sink: get_share_of_voice, get_ai_referrals · Destructive: analyze_discovery_readiness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_discovery_readiness, summarize_scan_evidence · Private data: build_visibility_action_plan · Public sink: get_share_of_voice, get_ai_referrals · Destructive: analyze_discovery_readiness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
